response.reason: The partner index for the real-FFT reconstruction is wrong: after the DIF stages the transform is stored as arr[i]=Z[rev(i)], so Z[M-k] lives at rev(M-k), but the kernel uses partner=(-address)&(M-1)=(-rev(k))&(M-1), which is not rev(M-k) in general (bit reversal does not commute with negation). E.g. with packed z=[1,i,0,0] (N=8-style trace), k=1 uses Z[1] as both operands and yields real part 2 instead of the exact ~1.707, an error far above tolerance; the same structural error occurs for all legal N (k=1 gives partner=rev(1)=M/2 instead of Z[M-1] at index M-1).
